generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractors should be registered in KPWD, License issued by Kpwd (Civil) Class 3 and above Registration and registered under E Procurement.

The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs. The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable.

All the items in the tender include all lead, lifts, loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery, cost and conveyance of all material and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detailed technical specification and direction of Engineer in charge of this work.
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Commissioner CMC Chikkaballapur reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
Contractor should compulsory deploy technically qualified persons to Supervise the works.

The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-1.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.
ALL RELEVANT DOCUMENTS TO BE UPLOADED SHOULD BE ORIGINAL AND IN PDF FORMAT
